card.name: Determiners before a following noun
card.fires_on: Short determiners or modifiers such as same, one, the, any, search, female and false that come right before a noun in ordinary prose. The next word is usually a plain noun such as source, respondent or lines.

modes.label: Determiner before noun
modes.description: Words like same, one, the or any that sit right after a preposition or conjunction and introduce a noun phrase.
modes.example: This opinion may have been derived from the<< same>> source.

modes.label: Modifier before noun
modes.description: Adjective or noun modifiers such as search, false or female that sit just before the noun they describe.

card.writes: It suppresses flavor-related words, which suggests it steers the next word away from that topic. Otherwise there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small words like "the", "one" or "same" that come just before a noun, mostly in general prose.
